housing.summary: Brussels has a competitive rental market; most long-term rentals are unfurnished and require a written lease registered with the regional authority. Furnished flats in central communes (Ixelles, Saint-Gilles, City of Brussels) carry a premium. A rental guarantee (deposit) is typically placed in a blocked bank account in the tenant's name.

banking.summary: Opening a resident current account generally requires proof of identity, proof of a Brussels address, and a National Register number (or proof of registration in progress). Some banks open a limited 'basic bank account' before full registration is complete.

schools.summary: Brussels schooling is split between the French Community and Flemish Community networks, alongside a large international and European school sector serving expatriate families. Enrolment in local schools runs through community-specific registration procedures.

legal_admin.summary: New residents must register at their local commune (commune/gemeente) of residence, which triggers an address verification by the local police and entry in the National Register. Registration is the gateway to most administrative services, including obtaining a residence card.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register in person at the commune/gemeente of your Brussels address to be entered in the National Register and obtain a residence document

tax_finance.summary: Belgian residents are identified for tax and administrative purposes by their National Register number, issued on registration at the commune. Residents file annual personal income tax with the federal tax administration; employment income is taxed via payroll withholding.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: National Register Number (Numéro de Registre National / Rijksregisternummer)

transport.summary: Brussels public transport (metro, tram, bus) is operated by STIB-MIVB, with regional and national rail complementing it. Monthly and annual travel passes are available on a rechargeable card. New residents from outside the EU/EEA may need to exchange their driving licence via their commune.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are valid; non-EU/EEA licences are exchanged through the commune of residence
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a health insurance fund (mutuelle / ziekenfonds) to access the statutory healthcare reimbursement system
